implemented_requirements.requirement: Read a text file from disk
implemented_requirements.evidence: FileReader.read_file() validates the path and returns the file content as a string (file_reader.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic words in the text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.detect() builds a list of single‑word hits using _is_palindrome() after normalising each token (palindrome_detector.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic multi‑word phrases in the text
implemented_requirements.evidence: PalindromeDetector.detect() iterates sliding windows of tokens (size 2..max_phrase_words) and checks the concatenated normalised string for palindrome (palindrome_detector.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Produce a human‑readable report and optionally save it
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReportGenerator.generate_report() formats statistics, word and phrase lists; print_report() prints to stdout; save_report() writes to a file (report_generator.py).

judge.summary: All core features for reading a file, detecting word and phrase palindromes, and reporting results are fully implemented with standard‑library code, making the program functional and likely executable.
